headline: A 1996 executive order on how the U.S. government keeps unofficial ties with the people of Taiwan.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets rules for how the federal government carries out its unofficial relationship with the people on Taiwan. The U.S. has not had formal diplomatic relations with Taiwan since 1979, so these ties run through unofficial channels. No summary was provided, so the order's specific instructions to agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on Taiwan-related matters
who_it_affects.how: They likely receive direction on how to handle dealings with Taiwan through unofficial arrangements.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 15, 1996; the exact effective date is not stated in the source material.
